newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Mobil to sign $1.67 bln deal with Pequiv.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to sign $1.67 bln deal with Pequiv.

text.p: Mobil Chemical Co, a unit of Mobil Corp, will sign a $1.67 billion joint venture deal on Thursday with Pequiven, the petrochemical wing of Venezuela's state-run Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) to develop an olefins complex.
Pequiven said Monday the "preliminary development agreement" will be signed by Mobil Corp Executive Vice President Eugene Renna and Pequiven President Arnold Volkenborn.

The project includes the construction at Jose, a seashore existing petrochemicals site in eastern Anzoategui state, of one olefins plant with an 830,000 tonnes per year capacity, two polyethylene plants with a combined capacity of 480,000 tonnes a year and one plant producing 430,000 tonnes per year of glycol.
A 50-50 joint venture company is expected to be formed by the end of the year with start-up for the complex scheduled for 1999.
